claim_boundary: This protocol compares adapted clean-room implementations of ExpeL, AWM, and ReasoningBank for cross-domain skill-memory transfer. It is not an exact execution of the upstream repositories and is not weight or policy transfer.

implementation_fidelity.required_table_footnote: ExpeL, AWM, and ReasoningBank are adapted clean-room implementations under one shared source/target harness, not exact upstream pipeline executions.
upgrade_to_exact_baseline_requires: upstream induction and retrieval path actually executed
compatibility adapter tests against upstream outputs

gated.artifact: unchanged admitted subset of source memory

estimands.primary: raw-panel intent-to-treat paired delta in official target success versus target-only
estimands.abstention_policy: An empty artifact remains in the denominator and executes as a byte-equivalent target-only no-op.
secondary: conditional utility among episodes with at least one retrieved item (descriptive only)
estimands.forbidden: Selecting tasks, methods, memories, or seeds using qualification/formal outcomes

paired_target_execution.input_token_overhead: same memory-token cap for every arm; report actual injected tokens and total prompt tokens

retrieval.memory_token_counter: unicode_lexical_v1 (deterministic shared budgeting unit); also report provider prompt tokens

requirements: one immutable task-ID list per target domain
initial-state or media hashes recorded before outcomes
all prior pilot and qualification tasks excluded
identical ordered tasks and seeds across target-only and all six memory arms
